metrics.final_message:
The `todos` package is written and passes `hd check --tests`, `hd test` (12 of 12), `hd fmt` and `hd lint`.

- **`src/todos.hd`** holds `Todo`, `TodoError`, `load`, `dump`, `complete` and `pending` with the signatures you gave. `Todo` and `TodoError` derive `Eq` and `Debug`. A missing `done` defaults to `false`. Any decode failure becomes `BadJson` with the decoder's message. `dump` uses the same JSON encoder, so `load` reads its output back unchanged.
- **`src/lib.hd`** re-exports the public API, so `pkg.load` and similar also work from other packages. `hd new --lib` scaffolded this file as the library root, and I kept it rather than deleting it.
- **`tests/todos.hd`** is an integration test through the package root. The unit tests are in the `tests:` block at the end of `src/todos.hd`.

Choices I made that you may want to change:
- An extra field in an object is ignored, not rejected, because that is how the derived JSON decoder behaves.
- Duplicate ids are accepted, and `complete` marks every todo with the matching id.
- `hd new` was run with `--vcs none`, since the directory is not a git repository. Nothing was committed.

The shell blocked one heredoc command with a permission denial, so I wrote the two test files with the file tool instead. The formatter then reformatted both files, and I re-ran check and test after that.
